author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Santander (shoulder) to resume hitting next week
desc: Anthony Santander is on track to resume hitting next week.
impact: Santander is on track to return in August. "He's very, very aware of how he feels so getting to the point to where you start hitting is a good thing, meaning you're feeling good," Blue Jays manager John Schneider said.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lenyn Sosa (wrist) nearing rehab assignment
desc: Lenyn Sosa is nearing a rehab assignment.
impact: The Blue Jays say Sosa is a little behind Addison Barger, who is expected to begin a rehab assignment this weekend or early next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Addison Barger (elbow) to begin rehab assignment soon
desc: Addison Barger is nearing a rehab assignment this weekend or early next week.
impact: Barger is on track to return by the end of June or early July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daulton Varsho (wrist) could return Saturday
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Daulton Varsho could be activated as early as Saturday.
impact: Varsho resumed swinging earlier this week. If he isn't activated sometime this weekend, it's possible he'll need a rehab game or two.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brett Kerry optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Angels optioned RHP Brett Kerry to Triple-A Salt Lake.
impact: Kerry made his major league debut on Wednesday, allowing two runs over four innings in relief. He gets sent down for the Angels to bring up a fresh arm.

author: Chase Davis
title: Michael Massey clubs key homer in win over Nationals
desc: Michael Massey went 1-for-4 in a 6-2 win over the Nationals with a home run, a run scored, and one RBI.
impact: After Wednesday's win, Massey is batting .261 with seven home runs, 24 RBI, 20 runs scored and one stolen base across 57 games. He's sat against each of the last four southpaws the Royals have faced, but is batting .267 in 31 plate appearances against them.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Porter optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Angels optioned C Logan Porter to Triple-A Salt Lake.
impact: Porter returns to Triple-A to make room for Tyler Heineman.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Roycroft optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Cardinals optioned RHP Chris Roycroft to Triple-A Memphis.
impact: Roycroft should see another opportunity in the majors later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Heliot Ramos (quad) collects one hit in rehab game
desc: Heliot Ramos went 1-for-5 with a run scored on Wednesday in a rehab game for Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Ramos began his rehab assignment on Wednesday. He should be activated by the end of June.

author: Chase Davis
title: Luinder Avila grinds out win as Royals top Nats
desc: Luinder Avila allowed one earned run on three hits and one walk while striking out five over 5.2 innings in Wednesday's win over the Nationals.
impact: After the win, Avila now has a 5.50 ERA and 1.65 WHIP with a 2-3 record through five starts. He bounced back after imploding against the Astros last time out. He allowed only three hard hits and picked up 12 whiffs on 91 pitches. He'll face the Rays next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Sandoval (biceps/elbow) works three innings in rehab start
desc: Patrick Sandoval allowed one run over three innings on Wednesday in a rehab start for Double-A Portland.
impact: Sandoval added four strikeouts in the rehab outing. He is likely on track to return at some point in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Quinn Priester (shoulder) to undergo surgery, miss rest of season
desc: Quinn Priester told reporters he will undergo decompression surgery on Monday and miss the remainder of the season.
impact: Priester suffered a setback on his way back from his injury. He'll begin his rehab process after surgery to get fully healthy for spring training.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brandon Sproat labors on mound against Guardians
desc:
Guardians

Brandon Sproat allowed four earned runs on two hits and two walks while striking out six over 3 2/3 innings in Wednesday's win over the Guardians.
impact: Sproat continues to struggle to miss opposing bats, allowing three earned runs or more in six of his last seven starts. The right-hander remains one of the more underwhelming options as part of a strong Brewers rotation for manager Pat Murphy, posting a 5.94 ERA and 1.46 WHIP with a 1-4 record and 1.97 K/BB ratio through 14 appearances.

author: Nate Miller
title: JR Ritchie struggles in early innings Wednesday night
desc: JR Ritchie allowed five runs on five hits and three walks while striking out four across five innings in Wednesday's 7-5 loss to the Giants.
impact: Ritchie was recalled from the minors this past week. He turned in a brilliant effort out of the Braves' bullpen in his first appearance back, going five scoreless innings against the Mets after Spencer Strider (elbow) exited. With Strider now on the shelf for an extended period, Ritchie re-entered the rotation Wednesday night. Things did not get off to a good start for the rookie, as he allowed a run in the first before surrendering four more on three homers in the second. Ritchie did show some moxy, however, settling down to roll off three consecutive shutout frames before leaving the game. Ritchie has shown promise in the bigs this season, but it's been mixed with inconsistency. He's more of a stash for fantasy purposes at the moment.

author: Nate Miller
title: Grant Holmes outing cut short by weather
desc: Grant Holmes gave up three runs on four hits and three walks while striking out two in Tuesday's 7-2 loss to the Giants.
impact: This game was postponed after just one and a half innings due to the weather in Atlanta on Tuesday night. The contest finished up Wednesday afternoon, but Holmes was obviously not a factor. The righty was not pitching particularly well for the Braves anyway, making it back-to-back rough outings. Holmes has now allowed six runs over just 5 2/3 innings while walking more batters than he's struck out. That's obviously not a positive trend.
